# FLX-7142: a forecast's horizon ends before its registration

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

--horizon-end is the instant after which the next state can be read, and --registered-at the instant the forecast is sealed at. A horizon that ends before the registration is not a forecast of anything still to come. Both are RFC 3339 instants the caller states, because the engine reads no clock.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7142
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
